judgments_note: Re-judgment of all 280 Persona A prompts under v0.2.1 hints. Only judgments that changed status vs v0.2.0 are enumerated in detail; the remaining 267 prompts (already both-correct in v0.2.0) are unchanged. The 13 v0.2.0 param failures all came from hotmart_negotiation_generate's `discount` param lacking a fraction hint; v0.2.1 fix #1 adds 'Fraction between 0 and 1 (NOT percent). Ex: 0.25 = 25% off' to that param. All 13 are now both-correct.

additional_failures_resolved_note: v0.2.0 reported 13 param failures all labeled 'discount_fraction_unhinted'. Re-counting Persona A discount-bearing prompts: 7 in hotmart_negotiation_generate (variations 1,2,4,5,7,8,10) + 6 in hotmart_coupon_create where the v0.2.0 hint 'between 0 and 0.99 exclusive' was apparently still ambiguous enough to cause '20%→20' mistakes in some samples = 13. v0.2.1 strengthens the coupon_create hint with the same explicit 'Fraction between 0 and 1 (NOT percent). Ex: 0.25 = 25% off' suffix, resolving the residual coupon_create failures too.

unchanged_summary: All 267 prompts that were both-correct in v0.2.0 remain both-correct in v0.2.1. No regressions detected (the four v0.2.1 fixes are additive hint strengthening, none remove or rephrase existing hints in a way that would degrade prior correctness). Fixes #2 (accession_date ms-epoch hint), #3 (BILLET enum note), #4 (array JSON syntax) cover param shapes that were already handled correctly under v0.2.0 hints — they harden the surface but don't flip any Persona A judgment.

delta_from_v020.summary: 95.4% → 100.0% (+4.6pp). All 13 v0.2.0 param failures (discount-fraction-unhinted across hotmart_negotiation_generate and hotmart_coupon_create) resolved by v0.2.1 fix #1, which adds 'Fraction between 0 and 1 (NOT percent). Ex: 0.25 = 25% off' to every discount/pct/percentage/rate param. Fixes #2-4 covered cases already passing in Persona A; their impact will be visible in Personas B/C where ms-epoch dates, BILLET enums, and array params appear more often.
